cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""KinDER single-episode controller; sensors and commands use rcb_client only.
Usage: python gen.py observe NAME | pose x y z rx ry rz NAME | joints q1 ... q7 NAME | grip VALUE N NAME
Saved actions.jsonl is an exact record of submitted control commands.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json, sys
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output'); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec()
(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
AX=np.array(spec['arm']['axis']); JP=np.array(spec['arm']['position_m'])
EE=np.array(spec['arm']['end_effector']['position_m'])
LO=np.array([-20,-2.24,-20,-2.57,-20,-2.09,-20]); HI=-LO

def transform(q):
    T=np.eye(4)
    for a,p,v in zip(AX,JP,q):
        R=Rotation.from_rotvec(a*v).as_matrix()
        M=np.eye(4); M[:3,:3]=R; M[:3,3]=p-R@p; T=T@M
    return T

def fk(q,point=EE):
    T=transform(q); return T[:3,:3]@point+T[:3,3],T[:3,:3]

def now():
    return np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'])

def observe(label='latest'):
    res=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'); res.save(OUT/label)
    p=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now']); pos,R=fk(p[6:13])
    print('STEP',res.meta['control_steps'],'DONE',res.meta['done'],res.meta['reason'])
    print('PROPRIO',p.tolist()); print('EE',pos.tolist(),'ROT',R.tolist())
    return res

def submit(A,label='move'):
    A=np.atleast_2d(A)
    with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps({'actions':A.tolist(),'note':label})+'\n')
    res=r.submit('delta',A,cameras=[],video='none',note=label)
    if res.done: print('EPISODE',res.meta); sys.exit(0)
    return np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'])

def movej(target,label='move',grip=None,maxsteps=100,speed=.08):
    p=now(); grip=(1. if p[20]>.5 else 0.) if grip is None else grip
    for k in range(maxsteps):
        d=np.clip(np.array(target)-p[6:13],-speed,speed)
        if max(abs(d))<.003: break
        A=np.zeros(11); A[3:10]=d; A[10]=grip
        p=submit(A,label)
    print('JOINT ERROR',np.array(target)-p[6:13],'iterations',k)
    return p

def ik(pos,rot,seed=None):
    if seed is None: seed=now()[6:13]
    def fun(q):
        p,R=fk(q)
        return np.r_[p-pos,Rotation.from_matrix(rot@R.T).as_rotvec()*.3]
    result=least_squares(fun,np.clip(seed,LO+1e-6,HI-1e-6),bounds=(LO,HI),max_nfev=500,xtol=1e-11,ftol=1e-11,gtol=1e-11)
    print('IK',result.x.tolist(),'error',fun(result.x).tolist())
    if np.linalg.norm(fun(result.x))>.005: raise ValueError('Unreachable pose')
    return result.x

if __name__=='__main__':
    mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'observe'
    if mode=='observe': observe(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'initial')
    elif mode=='pose':
        vals=np.array(list(map(float,sys.argv[2:8]))); target=ik(vals[:3],Rotation.from_rotvec(vals[3:]).as_matrix())
        movej(target,sys.argv[8]); observe(sys.argv[8])
    elif mode=='joints':
        movej(list(map(float,sys.argv[2:9])),sys.argv[9]); observe(sys.argv[9])
    elif mode=='grip':
        a=np.zeros(11); a[10]=float(sys.argv[2]); submit(np.tile(a,(int(sys.argv[3]),1)),sys.argv[4]); observe(sys.argv[4])
